meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你的 NanoClaw 项目里加入 DeltaChat 频道适配器:拉取适配器文件、装依赖、跑注册测试,让机器人通过邮箱收发端到端加密的 DeltaChat 消息。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目添加 DeltaChat 频道,或安装流程中需要接入 DeltaChat 时接管;每一步都可安全重复执行。

say.text: 帮我把 DeltaChat 频道集成到项目里
say.note: 拉取适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 把这张图设成机器人的 DeltaChat 头像
从日志里找出 DeltaChat 邀请链接
say.note: 取到邀请 URL 和二维码 SVG 路径

howto.what_en: After install, Claude adds a DeltaChat channel adapter to your NanoClaw project: installs the package, adds adapter files, runs the registration test, so the bot sends and receives encrypted DeltaChat messages over email.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a DeltaChat channel to the project, or need DeltaChat wired during setup. Every step is safe to re-run.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel to my project
say_en.note: Pulls the adapter, installs deps, runs the test

say_en.text: Set this image as the bot's DeltaChat avatar
say_en.note: Send the image with a /set-avatar caption; owner/admin only

say_en.text: Find the DeltaChat invite link in the logs
say_en.note: Returns the invite URL and QR SVG path
